# Recolour

Changes the colour of selected splats while optionally preserving their light and shade.

`lfs.recolour` · Colour

## How to use

Pick Colour and start with Weight 0.3 for a gentle tint.  
Leave Keep Shading on to retain lighting detail.  

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Geometry you want to edit. Connect a source; an unconnected input supplies no geometry. |
| Selection | `Selection` | lfs.float | 1 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01; accepts per-element values | Where you apply the edit, 0–1: 0 leaves it unchanged, 1 applies it fully. Unconnected means everything. |
| Colour | `Colour` | lfs.colour | [0.15000000596046448, 0.30000001192092896, 0.8500000238418579] | step 0.01 | Target RGB colour. Channels usually run from 0 to 1; the default is blue. Keep Shading retains light and shade. |
| Weight | `Weight` | lfs.float | 1 | min 0; max 1; step 0.01 | Recolour strength, 0–1. 0 keeps the original, 1 applies the full new colour; the default is 1. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Geometry | `Geometry` | lfs.geometry | — | — | Resulting geometry. Connect to another editing node or Group Output. |

## Settings

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Keep Shading | `keep_shading` | bool | true | — | Retain original light and shade while changing colour. On by default; off applies a flat colour. |
| Fade View Dependent | `fade_view_dependent` | bool | true | — | Reduce camera-dependent colour as you recolour. On by default; off retains the original variation. |
